mainEntity.name: How long does drywall finishing typically take for an average room?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time required for drywall finishing depends on the room size, the desired finish level, and the complexity of the space. For an average-sized room (e.g., 12x12 feet) requiring a Level 4 finish, the process often takes 3-5 days. This includes time for applying tape, multiple coats of joint compound, and adequate drying time between coats, which is critical. Rushing the drying process can lead to cracking or imperfections. Larger rooms or higher finish levels, such as Level 5, will naturally extend this timeline.
acceptedAnswer.description: Drywall finishing for an average room typically takes 3-5 days, depending on size and finish level. This accounts for multiple coats and essential drying time between applications.
